title: Rectangle Calculator
description: Enter length and width to get rectangle area, perimeter and diagonal with the formulas shown.
howto: Read the area, perimeter and diagonal.

faqs.a: By Pythagoras on the right triangle formed by the sides: d = √(l² + w²).

faqs.q: Is a square just a special rectangle?
faqs.a: Yes — enter equal length and width and the formulas still hold.
Area is the surface covered (square units); perimeter is the distance around (units).
